column1: # bridge/shlib/ampqmd.tsv: libomega-ampere-qmd.so.1, CUDApp's src/omega_ampere_qmd.c in Omega, from
# gpu/nvidia/om/encoder/amp_runtime.om, amp_qmd.om and bridge/shlib/ampqmd.om, one object. It needs the C
# library (memcpy and the pthread mutex). A trap answers -1, as the C does when its bridge call fails.
# Call rows: the policy with m NULL is refused (-1); the build with q NULL is refused (-1); the policy over buf
# (zeroed: op 0 is no amp_runtime operation) is refused (-1); then a build that amp_qmd accepts (0), its ten
# arguments with registers and shared_bytes on the caller's stack and every narrow argument's upper 32 bits set
# (AAPCS64 leaves them unspecified), and the 256 QMD bytes it writes to buf, word by word. The QMD words are
# what CUDApp's C omega_ampere_build_qmd writes for the same arguments (an oracle outside this tree printed them).
